title: Invoiced; Paid and part-sale work orders never appear
refs: SV-8654 (WIP spec v22 2026-08-18 S2-R5; open work on the as-of date)
preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. ZZAUTOTEST work orders exist at your active location open on the selected "as of" date: one Invoiced, one Paid, and one part-sale work order.
steps:
1. Open the Work In Progress report.
2. Look for the Invoiced and Paid work orders and the part-sale work order in every tab.
3. Check the summary strip and each tab's Totals row for their money.
4. Download the current tab as a CSV and search the file for them.
expected: 1. The Invoiced and Paid work orders do not appear in any tab, any Totals row, the summary strip, or the download. 2. The part-sale work order does not appear anywhere either. 3. No excluded work order's money is counted in any figure. --- This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Work In Progress report specification version 28 (S2-R5), read on 18 August 2026.
